name: Sabbatical Leave Application
description: Sabbatical leave request with required documentation (and, for professional development, a detailed plan and course syllabi).
deadline: On or before April 1 for the following school year; October 1 for the following semester
quote: Requests for sabbatical leaves, which include the required documentation, shall be made to the Superintendent or designee on or before April 1 for the following school year and October 1 for the following semester.
